# Metrics fixtures

Seeded-defect videos for `measure` are generated by `test/render/quality/metrics/metrics.test.ts` with FFmpeg lavfi sources (deterministic, nothing committed but this note and `audit-lines.json`):

- `clean-broll`: 4 s of moving test pattern at 30 fps; passes every hard check.
- `freeze`: 1.5 s moving, 3.0 s frozen, 1.5 s moving (still stretch 3.0 s, rhythm cap 6).
- `black-frame0`: one black frame, then moving pattern (frame-0 ink under 3%, hook cap 5).
- `overlay-full`: an RGBA overlay with an opaque box on every frame (fails `overlay-empty`).
- `overlay-clean`: the box appears at 0.2 s and leaves 0.5 s before the end.
- `key-clean` / `key-bleed`: a white disc on #00FF00, hard-edged or blurred into the key (fails `key-purity`).
- `one-frame`: a single frame measured against a 2 s plan (fails `duration`).

`audit-lines.json` is a minimal audit report (one line with ink box and colour) for the contrast measurement.
